title: IMPACT purification of native proteins
author: Brian Baltzar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gj2buqe
materials: Inspect the ligation with a colonyPCR
Make ON of the verified transformation
Lyse the cells using french press

steps.title: Digest pPCR product
steps.instruction: Digest the pPCR product with NdeI and SapI for a minimum of 2 hours.

steps.title: Transform plasmid into ER2566
steps.instruction: Transform the minipreped plasmid (from step 7) into E. coli strain ER2566 using an appropriate transformation method.

steps.title: Prepare chitin beads
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL chitin beads to a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Collect eluate in 0.5 mL aliquots
steps.instruction: Open the valve and drip the eluate into tubes, collecting 0.5 mL aliquots.

steps.title: Purify digest on columns
steps.instruction: Purify the digest on columns according to the preferred column protocol.

steps.title: Ligate purified digest
steps.instruction: Ligate the purified digest products using the preferred ligation protocol.

steps.title: TSB transformation into K‑12
steps.instruction: Perform a TSB transformation of the ligation mixture into E. coli K‑12 using your preferred transformation protocol.

steps.title: Miniprep plasmid from overnight culture
steps.instruction: Purify the plasmid from the overnight culture (step 1.7) using a miniprep kit.

steps.title: Inoculate 1 L LB+Amp
steps.instruction: Inoculate 1 L LB containing ampicillin with a fresh colony from the transformation above.

steps.title: Grow culture to OD 0.5–0.8
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C until the culture reaches an OD₆₀₀ of 0.5–0.8.

steps.title: Add IPTG to 0.4 mM
steps.instruction: Add IPTG to a final concentration of 0.4 mM.

steps.title: Incubate at 16–20 °C overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the culture at 16–20 °C overnight.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 1 L overnight culture at 5,000 × g, 4 °C for 15 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in 100 mL buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 mL cold column buffer (recipe in description).

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8,000 × g, 2 °C for 20 min and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in 2–4 mL buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in a small volume (2–4 mL) of cold column buffer.

steps.title: High‑speed centrifugation of lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 15,000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Low‑speed spin to remove debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the supernatant at 200 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash column with buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 50 mL column buffer.

steps.title: Second low‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Load clarified supernatant onto column
steps.instruction: Load the clarified supernatant (from step 18) onto the column.

steps.title: Spin column slowly for 2 h
steps.instruction: Attach the column to a rotor and spin slowly for 2 hours.

steps.title: Open valve and drip flow
steps.instruction: Open the valve just enough for the liquid to drip out slowly.

steps.title: Add column buffer
steps.instruction: Add column buffer until the flow stops.

steps.title: Add cleavage buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Close the valve, add cleavage buffer (enough to cover the beads plus 1 mL), and leave at room temperature overnight (minimum 16 h).

steps.title: Measure protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the protein concentration of the eluate.

steps.title: Pool high‑concentration aliquots
steps.instruction: Combine the aliquots with the highest concentrations and use the pooled sample for further work.
